Public Function Row(ByVal path As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, b As Excel.Button, e As String, s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path, 0, True)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error Resume Next
    Set b = ws.Buttons(1)
    Err.Clear
    b.DefaultButton = True
    e = e & ";" & Err.Number
    Set b = ws.Buttons(2)
    Err.Clear
    b.DefaultButton = True
    e = e & ";" & Err.Number
    For i = 1 To ws.Buttons.Count
        Set b = ws.Buttons(i)
        s = s & ";" & b.DefaultButton & "," & b.CancelButton & "," & b.HelpButton
    Next
    On Error GoTo 0
    wb.Close False
    Row = Mid(e, 2) & "|" & Mid(s, 2)
End Function
